log: Working out who would actually buy this
Discovering candidates and exact source URLs (stage 1 of 2)
Fetching up to 10 exact URLs; validating against at most 48,000 characters
Evaluating candidates against 5 fetched pages (stage 2 of 2)

Coverage gaps. Reddit is not fetchable by this agent, and it is the single most likely venue for this product's buyer complaints; every attempt to reach buyer voices there failed, so the map leans on forum posts, marketplace listings and live published pages instead. That biases the evidence toward observable artefacts over stated pain. Search results also arrived as summaries rather than raw quotations in several cases, so the returned URLs should be fetched and read before any claim here is treated as sourced. Unsuccessful or thin searches: direct buyer complaints about hitting plan ceilings; anything on uptime, ownership, company size or longevity, which is the blocking objection for the client-site studio and is unanswered in both the supplied catalogue and the public sources I reached; consent and data-processing terms for forms, which matters for the discount-for-email segment; and any first-party customer story, testimonial or named case study for this product. Leads seen but not promoted for want of evidence: cafes, food trucks and small restaurants using a one-pager as a QR-code menu, where a template and widget ecosystem clearly exists but I found no operator voice and no purchase evidence, so it needs its own pass; coaches and course creators running a payment-enabled sales page, where free payment links undercut the need; and local service solos such as tattoo artists, where booking-specific platforms own the workflow end to end. Population figures are unknown throughout and I have not estimated any. Segment kinds are descriptive labels, not a quota; four of the seven are core-shaped buyers and I did not manufacture an influencer or unintended-use segment to fill the taxonomy. One capability caveat: the maker programme underpinning the template-designer candidate is not present in the supplied capability catalogue, so that candidate's required capabilities list only the supplied template-building, template-sharing and premium-template facts.
7 audience(s) mapped; 0 worth exploring first. Commercial priority is a hypothesis, not a response-rate forecast.
